description: This file defines an interface for basket view model services in a web application, specifying methods for retrieving or creating a basket, counting items, and mapping basket entities to view models.

classes.name: IBasketViewModelService
classes.description: An interface defining methods for basket-related operations in the web application.

methods.name: GetOrCreateBasketForUser
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves an existing basket or creates a new one for the specified user.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Asynchronously counts the total number of items in the user's basket.

methods.name: Map
methods.description: Converts a Basket entity to a BasketViewModel for presentation purposes.
